ModMetaData.name: World Tile Scouting
ModMetaData.author: local
ModMetaData.description: After ground-penetrating scanner research, remotely scout world sites and settlements. Reports use site threat patterns (faction outpost/work site, mechanoids, manhunters, anomaly distress, ambush deferred, etc.) via PawnGroupMaker examples — not live map ESP and not a hardcoded quest list. Concurrent scouts are capped at ceil(free colonists ÷ N) (min 1; N configurable, default 5). Intel lasts until raid, fingerprint change, or expiry. Hard-depends only on Harmony; Anomaly/Royalty/Odyssey patterns activate when those DLCs are present.
